what: Class WAKE-UP (ruling 4; M01, M02, M03, P05): the perfusion criterion is now 'Extended-window imaging: CT perfusion or MRI with DWI and FLAIR' (either alternative), REQUIRED and in the stop rule. P04 already had CTP required in the stop rule. FLAIR clarified in the MRI report: the acute cortical lesion is clearly FLAIR-positive, separate from the Fazekas 2-3 periventricular and deep white-matter disease (finding, additional observation and impression item 4 no longer say it is 'partially obscured').

Class NIHSS-ITEM3 (ruling 5): visual extinction with intact fields scores 0 on item 3 and counts only on item 11; recounted in M01, M02, M03 (9 to 8), RP04 (6 to 5), S01 (23 to 22) and S05 (14 to 13) in the exam, key evidence and musts. RS05 already followed the rule. No reperfusion decision changes. The dataset grep found extinction only in two ALZ-EARLY exams, which have no NIHSS.

TTE now recommended and out of the stop rule. Class STOP-SCOPE (ruling 3, all 30 ISCH-STR cases): the benchmark has one final assessment, so the stop rule holds the acute decision work-up (NCCT, CTA, perfusion or MRI where the decision needs it, admission bloods, ECG). Drug-interaction checks, TTE, Holter/telemetry and extra panels went from required to recommended and out of required_before_assessment (22 cases), except where the accepted diagnosis names the etiology the test establishes: those stay required but leave the stop rule (M01, M02, M03 rhythm monitoring for the paroxysmal AF; P03 cultures, TTE and TEE; P05 venous duplex and bubble echo; RP03 bubble echo; RP04 antiphospholipid panel; RP05 NOTCH3).

Class SWALLOW (ruling 6): a must 'Screen swallowing at the bedside with a validated tool before any oral food, fluids or oral medication, and keep nil by mouth until the screen is passed (AHA/ASA 2026)' added to 24 ISCH-STR cases that lacked one, with aspiration precautions where the case has dysarthria (and in P04 for the severe MCA syndrome). Not added to M04, RP01, RP03, RS03 (already present) or RM02, RM03 (no neurological deficit).
